    Conditional QCE_p -> native non-CEP witness #

    This file wires the committed CEP substrate to the conditional chain

    QCE_p -> FlexibleHSStable Gamma_p -> exists non-hyperlinear group -> exists non-Connes-embeddable tracial state.

    Every open input is a named Prop carried as an explicit hypothesis of the final theorem: QCE_p itself, the uniform vertex stability with recombination, the Dogon-Vigdorovich central extension and obstruction, and the canonical faithful tracial group model. None is an axiom and none is a sorry; the file contains no sorry at all, and what remains open is visible in the statement of qce_implies_cep_false rather than hidden in its proof.

    The vertex stability and the recombination are deliberately a single input. Splitting them is unsound: with an unconstrained multiplicative-defect bound the recombination claim is false, since nothing then ties the defect of the amalgam representation to the vertex budgets.

    Mathematical status: the completeness analysis (cep_formalization_program.md) shows the relative-conjugation/Fourier obstruction family is the ONLY QCE_p-obstructing class and is killed by the full unipotent edge generator, so QCE_p is the single genuine open core of the rank-1 native non-CEP route.

                            def ZFib.CEP.QCE_p (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
                            Prop

                            QCE_p: quantitative commensurated-edge rigidity for SL2(Z[1/p]).

                            Uniform-modulus form: for every Hilbert-Schmidt tolerance eps, there is a dimension- independent edge tolerance delta such that any finite-dimensional pair of exact vertex representations which agrees on the edge subgroup up to delta is eps-close to a pair which agrees on the edge subgroup exactly.

                                      def ZFib.CEP.SerreVertexStabilityWithGluing {p : ℕ} (D : Substrate.SerreAmalgamData p) :
                                      Prop

                                      Uniform vertex stability with recombination — an open input, stated and not proved.

                                      Flexible Hilbert–Schmidt stability of the vertex group SL₂(ℤ) together with a recombination principle that holds at the same modulus: for a target vertex accuracy epsV there is one deltaV such that every approximate representation of defect below deltaV is epsV-close to an exact vertex representation, and any such representation whose two vertex restrictions have been corrected to an exactly-agreeing pair recombines to an eps-close exact representation of the amalgam whenever the budgets satisfy epsQ + epsV < eps.

                                      The two halves are deliberately not separate hypotheses. Separating them is unsound: with an unconstrained defect bound the recombination claim is false, since nothing then ties the multiplicative defect of the amalgam representation to the vertex budgets. Sharing the modulus is the mathematical content that a genuine relative-stability theorem for the amalgam would supply.

                                                def ZFib.CEP.DVCentralExtensionAvailable (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
                                                Prop

                                                The Dogon–Vigdorovich central extension — an open input, stated and not proved.

                                                Constructing it means instantiating a finite presentation of SL₂(ℤ[1/p]) from the Bass–Serre substrate, adjoining the central LCS generator and the cocycle relators of the finitely presented central extension, and proving the quotient map surjective with central kernel containing the LCS involution.

                                                            Conditional non-CEP along the rank-one route.

                                                            Every open input is a named hypothesis of this statement rather than a gap inside its proof: the uniform vertex stability with recombination, the Dogon–Vigdorovich central extension and obstruction, the canonical faithful tracial group model, and the rigidity statement QCE_p itself. None of them is proved in this development, and QCE_p is diagnosed as unreachable by the route computed in the accompanying analysis.
